mechanism: Hydrochlorothiazide causes volume depletion and electrolyte imbalances (hypokalemia, hyponatremia) that increase aminoglycoside nephrotoxicity and ototoxicity risk.
action: Monitor renal function, serum electrolytes, and tobramycin levels closely; maintain adequate hydration; consider alternative diuretic if possible; assess for ototoxicity and nephrotoxicity signs.
